info.description: Admin aliases are documented for compatibility, not counted as additional business functionality. Examples contain placeholders only. Query parameters are strict and cannot be duplicated. Decimal database values are serialized as strings. HTTP HEAD and approved CORS OPTIONS are bodyless; unsupported methods use Next.js 405 responses.

get.description: No authentication. Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream). Sends retry, then `event: tracking` with the same public shape as GET /track/{trackingNumber}, then a new tracking event only when the timeline changes (server checks every 5 seconds). `: heartbeat` comments every 25 seconds. Ends with `event: end` and data {reason}: final (DELIVERED, RETURNED or CANCELLED), gone (shipment removed), error (repeated lookup failures) or timeout (after 270 seconds; reconnect). Rate limit: 30 connections per 15 minutes per client.

post.description: ADMIN only. Returns today's saved brief (cached: true) without calling the AI provider, unless refresh is true. Otherwise summarises server-side figures (status counts, today's bookings and deliveries, failed shipments, shipments with no update for 48 hours, paid shipments with no courier, pending payments) with tracking numbers but no customer names, phones or addresses. facts holds the exact figures used. brief.unverified lists any number in the text that is not in facts. New briefs are rate limited per admin (3 per 15 minutes) and saved in an AI_OPS_BRIEF audit record, which is the per-day cache; failures write AI_OPS_BRIEF_FAILED. 502 AI_UPSTREAM_ERROR; 503 AI_UNAVAILABLE, AI_BUSY or AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.

post.description: CUSTOMER or COURIER only. Read-only: answers from the caller's own shipments and payments through role-scoped tools and never changes data. Messages alternate and start and end with the user; only visible text is accepted. The caller's 5 newest shipments are preloaded so common questions need one model call; shipments lists records named in the reply for linking. Rate limited per user (20 requests per 15 minutes). Returns 503 AI_UNAVAILABLE when AI is disabled, 503 AI_BUSY or 502 AI_UPSTREAM_ERROR on provider failures. Each request writes an AI_ASSISTANT_QUERY audit record with tool names, record ids and token counts, never message text.

get.description: ADMIN only. Aggregated in SQL with Asia/Dhaka day boundaries. booked counts non-deleted shipments created in the range; delivered counts deliveries in the range; revenue is BDT received (paidAt) minus full refunds (refundedAt) as a decimal string, including payments for archived shipments. onTimeRate is the share of deliveries within 72 hours of first pickup (deliveries without a recorded pickup are not timed); median and p90 delivery hours use the same times. failureRate is failed / (delivered + failed). previous is the same number of days immediately before; change is a percentage for booked, delivered and revenue, and a difference in points or hours for the rest. Top 5 origin hubs and up to 10 couriers. Cached for 5 minutes per range (cached: true when served from cache).

post.description: Provider-only endpoint; no bearer token. Requires original signed JSON body (maximum 256 KiB), valid recent signature and matching account/mode. Server verifies payment metadata, amount and currency against Stripe. Duplicate events are acknowledged without repeating changes; unrelated events are ignored. A 503 requests a retry. Send real signed events through Stripe CLI; the Postman reference body alone cannot simulate a valid payment.
